Sultan Muhammad Fateh

Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı — release dates and subtitle guides.

Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı follows Sultan Mehmed II in a Turkish historical drama broadcast by TRT 1. The same series is commonly searched as Sultan Muhammad Fateh, Sultan Mehmed Fateh and Sultan Fatih. Serkan Çayoğlu plays Mehmed in the official TRT cast listing.

Start with Season 4

This guide currently covers Season 4, beginning at original Episode 84. Four episodes are released; the fifth is scheduled. Each episode has a separate Urdu-subtitle and English-subtitle viewing guide, with original dates, publisher verification and story sources.

Season 4 episode listBroadcast dates

Choose your subtitle edition

Urdu subtitles and English subtitles accompany the Turkish original. Urdu dubbing is a separate spoken-audio edition and can divide broadcasts differently.

Understand the episode numbers

Season 4 Episode 1 is original Episode 84. Season 4 Episode 4 is original Episode 87. Both numbers appear together across the site so you can match provider listings without mixing in a dubbed cut.
